items.title: Vitalik Buterin Outlines 'Cryptographic World Computer' Plan for Ethereum
items.body: Hegota will be Ethereum's last 'normal' fork, he argues, with everything after built on recursive STARKs and formal verification.

items.title: The restaking gold rush is over, and top protocols are barely making a profit
items.body: As restaking yields dried up and smart-contract risks mounted, Ethereum's top liquid restaking protocol walked away from its core business to build a crypto neobank instead.

items.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine Buys Another $47M of ETH, Taking It to 4.9% of Ethereum Supply
items.body: Bitmine has staked 84% of its tokens, a position it projects will generate some $358 million a year in staking rewards.

items.title: Vitalik Buterin says Hegotá could be Ethereum’s last ‘normal’ fork
items.body: Ethereum’s Vitalik Buterin said PeerDAS marked the start of Ethereum’s transition “from being just a blockchain to being something much more powerful.”

items.title: THORChain under fire over Bitget, ETH evolves beyond blockchain: Hodler’s Digest
items.body: THORChain refuses to blacklist addresses linked to the Bitget hack. Vitalik Buterin says Ethereum is evolving from being a mere blockchain, into a world cryptographic computer.

items.title: Vitalik Buterin maps Ethereum’s shift beyond a blockchain in sweeping 2030 vision
items.body: Buterin wants Ethereum to do far more work without forcing every computer on the network to repeat the same calculations.
